articles.title: RFA Awarded ESA Flight Ticket Initiative Launch Contracts
articles.summary:
German rocket builder Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) has been awarded launch service contracts for two missions under the Flight Ticket Initiative. The Flight Ticket Initiative is a programme run jointly by the European Space Agency (ESA) and the European Union that provides subsidised launch opportunities for European companies and organisations on small launch vehicles. articles.title: NASA Awards Global Modeling, Assimilation Support Contract
articles.summary: NASA has selected ADNET Systems, Inc. of Bethesda, Maryland, to provide global modeling and data assimilation support at the agency’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. articles.title: NASA Selects Participants to Track Artemis II Mission
articles.summary: NASA has selected 34 global volunteers to track the Orion spacecraft during the crewed Artemis II mission’s journey around the Moon. The Artemis II test flight will launch NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket, carrying the Orion spacecraft and a crew of four astronauts, on a mission into deep space.
